Bihar Encounter Killing Sparks Political Debate and Legal Scrutiny

The encounter killing of Bharat Tiwari in Bihar has triggered significant political debate and legal challenges. While some political figures have supported the police action, others have raised questions, leading to calls for a Supreme Court probe. Tiwari was reportedly killed in an encounter after allegedly making anti-government posts.
